analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($334.56) above SMA5 ($330.46), below SMA20 ($380.08): indicating short-term weakness and medium-term weakness.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($457.70) and SMA200 ($379.47): signaling long-term trend weakening.
· 52-week position (40.3%): current price level is in the lower half of the 52-week range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.1→38.7): entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.8999→-4.8492): continued worsening, reinforcing bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $306.75): approaching lower band, with a band width of 38.59% suggesting potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($323.29): support level based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($365.90): resistance level below Pivot R1.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low formation): signaling continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.68x): subdued volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): maintaining a wait-and-see approach, with potential for further decline if 20-day low is breached.
